props.title: TL;DR
props.message: Fresh "data analyst" reqs split into two tracks — GCC cloud/ML-stack roles and legacy-BI agency roles; only the modern-stack side reaches ₹15L+.

props.title: Trelleborg — BI & Data Analyst, Bengaluru, ₹15–17L (posted Sep 30)

props.text: The one fresh req stating comp at or above your ₹15L bar: 3–9 yrs, but the stack is legacy — SAP BW, Informatica PowerCenter, IBM Cognos, Oracle PL/SQL, SQL Server.
Why it matters: it clears the target band today; the legacy tooling is the trade-off, so treat it as a reskilling decision, not a straight win.
Freshest concrete role: mid-level, 4+ yrs, gated on SQL, Power BI, Snowflake, Azure Data Factory and Python, with Tableau and Databricks preferred. Comp not stated.
Why it matters: this is the new analyst baseline — cloud warehouse plus pipeline tooling, not Power BI alone.
Market-research firm, 5–10 yrs, hybrid; stack is Python, R, SQL, ML, Docker, REST APIs, Azure/GCS. Comp not stated.
Why it matters: a product-side analyst seat outside the IT-services layer where BI pay plateaus.

props.title: American Express — Analyst Data Science, Gurugram/Bengaluru (posted Oct 2)

props.text: 0–30 months, master's required; the JD demands SAS, R, Python, Hive, Spark and ML. Comp not stated.
Why it matters: the entry rung of "analyst" now expects big-data and ML tooling — a learn-next signal, not a ≥₹15L seat (too junior).
Velocity (White Wizard) Data Analyst, Bengaluru — ₹18–25L + equity, but a Tier-1-institute gate and a month-old listing
GCC entry-level analyst band sits at ₹10–18L (Taggd, Sep 4); the ₹15L+ end clusters in cloud/ML-stack reqs, not Power-BI-only ones.
